question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Mrs. Meera and family / received his letter / a week ago.
solution:
The correct answer is: **No error**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is "**Mrs. Meera and family.**" The use of "**and family**" is a **collective reference** to Mrs. Meera's entire family.
 
• The verb "**received**" is appropriately used to agree with the plural subject.
 
• The pronoun "**his**" is used to refer to a male person, and it is assumed to be clear in the context whose letter is being referred to.
 
• The time expression "**a week ago**" is appropriately used to indicate when the action (receiving the letter) took place.
 
• Therefore, the sentence is both grammatically and conceptually correct.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.
